Title: Add a new pet — valid payload
Steps:
1. Send POST /pet with valid JSON body (name, photoUrls, status)
2. Verify response status
3. Verify response body contains pet ID and name
Expected Result: Status 200. Response contains pet with matching name, category, and status. Pet ID is returned.

Title: Update an existing pet
Preconditions: Pet ID 91001 exists in the store
Steps:
1. Send PUT /pet with updated status (sold)
2. Verify response
3. Send GET /pet/{petId} to confirm update
Expected Result: Status 200. Pet status updated to 'sold'. GET confirms the change persisted.

Title: Find pets by status — available
Preconditions: At least one pet with status 'available' exists
Steps:
1. Send GET /pet/findByStatus?status=available
2. Verify response is a non-empty array
3. Verify all returned pets have status 'available'
Expected Result: Status 200. Array of pets returned. Every pet object has status = 'available'.

Title: Find pets by tags (deprecated endpoint)
Steps:
1. Send GET /pet/findByTags?tags=golden-retriever
2. Verify response
3. Note: endpoint is marked deprecated in spec
Expected Result: Status 200. Array returned (endpoint still responds despite deprecation). No sunset header present.

Title: Get pet by valid ID
Steps:
1. Send GET /pet/{petId} with a valid pet ID
2. Verify response status and body structure
3. Verify required fields: id, name, photoUrls
Expected Result: Status 200. Response contains pet with correct ID, name, photoUrls, and status.

Title: Update pet with form data
Steps:
1. Send POST /pet/{petId} with Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
2. Include name and status fields
3. Verify update via GET
Expected Result: Status 200. Pet name and status updated when retrieved.

Title: Delete a pet
Steps:
1. Send DELETE /pet/{petId} with api_key header
2. Verify response
3. Send GET /pet/{petId} to confirm deletion
Expected Result: Status 200 on delete. Subsequent GET returns 404.

Title: Upload pet image
Steps:
1. Send POST /pet/{petId}/uploadImage with multipart/form-data
2. Include an image file and additionalMetadata
3. Verify response
Expected Result: Status 200. ApiResponse with code 200 and message containing 'File uploaded'.
